pcb-analysis.description: Read-only PCB analysis for KiCadRoutingTools AI skills: may run the repo's checkers/analysis tools and fetch datasheets, but must not modify files. The GUI's headless skill runs select this agent (kicad_routing_plugin/ai_backend.py) as the opencode equivalent of the Claude Code --allowedTools Read,Glob,Grep,Bash,WebSearch allowlist.
